description: This file contains the implementation of a decorator class CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator which adds caching behavior to catalog item service methods using local storage. It manages caching of catalog items list with a 1-minute expiry and wraps basic CRUD operations.

classes.name: CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class implementing ICatalogItemService to add caching via local storage for catalog items.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of catalog items, using cache if valid.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns the full list of catalog items, using cache if valid.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by its ID from the cached list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: RefreshLocalStorageList
methods.description: Refreshes the local storage cache of the catalog items list.
